notes: Image-generated mockup is a visual reference, not exact geometry. This proposal retains functional massing and specifies additional facade details; it is not a 1:1 image reconstruction.
Area boxes are measurement envelopes and intentionally overlap where wings, towers, gatehouse, and keep join. Every voxel has exactly one final state.
Snapshot includes existing terrain and approach context. Do not paste the whole rectangular volume into the active world. No world writer is included.
Block-state inventory counts placed states in the snapshot, including terrain; it is not a survival crafting estimate.
No block entities are serialized; not an importable Minecraft structure file.
Slab/stair orientations are exact; route graph checks 0.5-block steps and two-block headroom, not full Minecraft collision simulation.
